title: T811-900GS OPTIMIZATION OF LASER INTENSITY ON SPACE DEBRIS VIA COHERENT BEAM COMBINATION (EXPRO+)
description: Recently, strategies have been explored to perturb space debris orbits using high-power ground-based lasersystems. This method, known as laser momentum transfer, can also be used for deep-space opticalcommunications. Multi-beam architectures have been designed and implemented to obtain the required powerlevels that would be unachievable with a single laser source or that would be limited by atmospheric turbulenceeffects. In a recent study on laser momentum transfer, 40 kW-class lasers based on multiple beams have beenproposed to alter the orbits of space debris and prevent collisions with active satellites.One challenge is delivering the generated power to the selected target while minimizing losses caused by laserpropagation and ensuring efficient momentum transfer for collision avoidance manoeuvres. Adaptive opticssystems have been considered but there are still several challenges due to the limited maturity of thistechnology. For example, retrieving tip-tilt information to compensate for atmospheric turbulence still dependson sunlight reflected from debris, which is a limiting factor in operational terms. Additionally, today's deformablemirror technology is not mature enough for the power levels needed for this application. While research is stillongoing, Coherent Beam Combining (CBC) techniques could offer a valid alternative to mitigate atmosphericeffects. This approach has the potential to correct the negative impact of atmospheric turbulence in systemsinvolving multiple beams.This activity aims at investigating CBC techniques to concentrate the highest possible intensity on the target,dynamically adjusting the phase of each beam, and achieving an optimal relationship between the phases ofthe multiple beams.Procurement Policy: C(1) = Activities in open competition limited to the-non-Large-System Integrators. title: Germany – Heating, ventilation and air-conditioning installation work – Wärmeversorgungsanlagen
description: Die drei Krankenhäuser Aurich, Emden, Norden sollen zu einer Klinik zusammengeführt werden. Geplant ist der Bau eines aufgelösten Komplexes aus mehreren Gebäuden mit den dazugehörigen Verkehrs-, Park- und Freiflächen. Mit der Zentralklinik entsteht ein modernes und zentral zwischen den Städten Aurich, Emden und Norden gelegenes 814-Betten-Haus auf einem 36 Hektar großen Areal in Uthwerdum. Das Baugrundstück befindet sich bei Uthwerdum ein Ortsteil der Gemeinde Südbrookmerland im Landkreis Aurich in Ostfriesland. Die Erschließung des Geländes erfolgt über die südlich angrenzenden Bundesstraßen B72 und B21. Bestandteil der Ausschreibung ist die Lieferung und Montage von Komponenten der KGR 480 - Gebäudeautomation in den Gebäuden Versorgungszentrum, Somatik, Zentrum Seelischer Genesung und Energiezentrale. title: Ireland – Education and training services – Communication & Online Learning Enhancement & Scientific Advisory (UCC-VEAT-2024-07)
description: This is a voluntary ex-ante transparency (VEAT) notice. It acknowledges that University College Cork (UCC) contracted with Stichting Climate-KIC International Foundation (Climate-KIC), for the provision of support and leadership of online and in-person training event implementation for the Copernicus Atmospheric Monitoring Service and Copernicus Climate Change Service, under the competitively won ECMWF Service Contract CJS2_156b_UCC. Under CJS2_156b_UCC, UCC is leading a Service team to provide support to the ECMWF in implementing training events and online learning resources for the two Copernicus Services. Climate-KIC will lead the event implementation activities for the overall Service contract, and contribute to the Scientific Advisory Committee. Climate-KIC were uniquely placed in terms of skillsets, professional networks and relationships to perform their role in this overall service contract, further enhanced by their good standing, and track record of excellence. They brought their extensive networks in the worlds of business, academia, and the public and non-profit sectors into the Service team. For example, Climate-KIC are an official member of the Copernicus Academy since 2018 which has equipped them with an exceptional insight into the educational and training landscape of the Copernicus Programme - a critical requirement for this work. In addition, Climate-KIC is already active across Europe and online, running a range of inspirational education programmes for students, postgraduates, and professionals. This is in alignment with the requirements of the Service contract, specifically in delivering high-quality, customised Training events for the 2 Copernicus Services (Atmospheric and Climate) operated by the ECMWF. Within their staff, Climate-KIC also had the required expertise in event management, professional networks, Copernicus activities, Copernicus product uses, and product & service development that was needed for the Service’s Scientific Advisory Committee - a key Quality Control mechanism embedded within the contract Service – in addition to their highly beneficial professional networks. This is in close alignment with the requirements of the overarching Service contract between UCC and the ECMWF, specifically to deliver high-quality, customised online and in-person training events that are quality controlled to a standard of high scientific and professional rigour. The company was therefore selected to participate in the bid for the CJS2_156b ITT as their unique combination of skillsets, technical expertise, capabilities and networks complemented those of the bidding consortium, completing it’s offering to the ECMWF. They were integral to the awarded bid, and have been contracted accordingly.

title: Germany – Pharmaceutical products – Abschluss einer nicht-exklusiven Rabattvereinbarung nach § 130a Abs. 8 SGB V zum Wirkstoff Tofacitinib, ATC L04AF01 für die Zeit 01.09.2025 - 31.08.2027 (zzgl. Verlängerungsoption 1x12 Monate)
description: § 130a Absatz 8 SGB V ermöglicht den Krankenkassen und pharmazeutischen Unternehmen, Rahmenrabattverträge über die zu Lasten der gesetzlichen Krankenkassen abzugebenden Arzneimittel zuschließen. In Hinblick auf die dafür einschlägigen gesetzlichen Vorschriften zur Vergabe öffentlicher Aufträge, findet ein regelmäßiger Prozess wirkstoffbezogener, förmlicher Vergabeverfahren nach den Regularien des 4. Teils des GWB durch die DAK-Gesundheit statt. Für vom Bieter näher in der Anlage 2 zum Vertrag zu benennende Arzneimittel zu dem o. g. Wirkstoff Tofacitinib, ATC L04AF01, beabsichtigt die DAK-Gesundheit, bis zum Inkrafttreten neuer Arzneimittelrabattverträge mit möglichst allen interessierten pharmazeutischen Unternehmen Arzneimittelrabattverträge abzuschließen. Ein Rabattvertrag i.R.d. Zulassungsmodells zu dem o. g. Wirkstoff tritt erstmals am 01.09.2025 in Kraft und endet am 31.08.2027 (zzgl. Verlängerungsoption 1x12 Monate). Er endet unabhängig davon automatisch mit Inkrafttreten des Exklusivvertrages.

title: Servicii pentru dezvoltare, actualizare și mentenanță a unei aplicații geospațiale pentru primire a cererilor unice de sprijin (o nouă platformă GIS – Geo-spatial Aid Application - GSAA.
description:
Servicii pentru dezvoltare, actualizare și mentenanță a unei aplicații geospațiale pentru primire a cererilor unice de sprijin (o nouă platformă GIS – Geo-spatial Aid Application - GSAA -)”, în vederea îndeplinirii activitatilor specifice institutiei în directia gestionării fondurilor europene si nationale destinate sprijinirii agriculturii, ținând cont și de noul context al politicii agricole comune ce urmează a fi pusă în aplicare în perioada 2023-2027. Aplic. IPA-Online utilizata la acest moment a fost dezvoltata pe o platforma veche ce nu mai suportă actualizari. Această aplicatie este un sistem informatic destinat ptr.primirea cererilor unice de plată depuse de fermieri. Aplicatia noua trebuie să răspunda cerintelor actuale ale APIA, conform caietului de sarcini Obiectul prezentei achizitii si ale Ac. cadru care urmează a fi atribuit, cuprinde patru mari categ.de servicii: 1.Dezvoltarea primară a platformei GIS pe o tehnologie nouă care să preia / adapteze funcționalități existente în actuala aplicație GIS de digitizare a parcelelor (IPA - Online), 2.Dezvoltarea de funcționalitati noi în funcție de necesitatile achizitorului, după punerea în funcțiune a platformei de la punctul 1; 3. Componenta de întreținere a aplicatiilor și servelor pe care aceasta rulează în parametri optimi atât pentru sistemul de productie cât și cel de test; 4. Asigurarea unui centru de asistenta și suport ptr. înregistrarea și remedierea incidentelor semnalate de utilizatori . În baza acordului-cadru se vor atribui contracte subsecvente care vor constitui temei legal pentru plată, în funcție de necesitățile autorității contractante. Contractele subsecvente se vor încheia cu respectarea tarifelor unitare pentru fiecare categorie de servicii în parte prevăzute în acordul-cadru şi cu încadrarea în fondurile bugetare alocate. Tarifele unitare prevăzute în acordul cadru, actualizate, după caz, vor guverna toate contractele subsecvente care urmează a fi atribuite pe parcursul derulării acordului cadru. Acordul-cadru va fi guvernat de tarife unitare specifice pentru fiecare categorie de servicii (tarife unitare/zi om pentru serviciile de dezvoltare de functionalităţi noi, respectiv tarife unitare lunare/abonament pentru serviciile de intretinere, asistenţă şi suport,suport și mentenanţă), tarife unitare care vor sta la baza atribuirii tuturor contractelor subsecvente care vor fi încheiate pe parcursul derulării acordului-cadru. Acordul cadru se va încheia cu un singur operator economic , pe o durata de 48 de luni. Calendarul estimativ de aplicare a procedurii de atribuire a acordului-cadru: Se estimeaza ca Acordul-cadru se va aplica în perioada: mai 2023 – mai 2027. Se estimează ca se vor atribui între 2 și 4 contracte subsecvente pe an în funcție de necesitățile APIA, ori de câte ori apare această necesitate. Descrierea detaliata a serviciilor care se solicita a fi realizate, precum și cerințele tehnice ale serviciilor, sunt prezentate în Caietul de sarcini. Operatorii economici pot solicita clarificări cu un număr de 18 zile înainte de data limită de depunere a ofertelor. Autoritatea contractantă va elabora şi posta în SICAP răspunsul la toate solicitările de clarificări depuse în termenul de mai sus, în a 11- a zi înainte de data limită de depunere a ofertelor.

title: DEVELOPMENT OF ON-ORBIT MANUFACTURING PROCESS FOR LARGE ANTENNA REFLECTOR - EXPRO PLUS
description: To select, develop and demonstrate on a breadboard a process relevant for on-orbit manufacturingof large antenna reflectors.DescriptionThe size of the Telecommunication satellites is limited by the dimensions of the launcher fairings.This applies to components of the satellites where a larger size results in increased performance and capability of the system. Larger solar arrays result in more power available for a given platform and increased payload capability. Larger antenna reflectors lead to a smaller emitted beam and therefore higher gain, higher data throughput and the ability to divide the available power between an increased number of smaller beams. Current solutions for large reflectors rely on deployablesystems, which have highly complex manufacturing and testing routes, which result in long lead times and high cost. The ability to manufacture antenna reflectors and booms on orbit allows to alleviate the limitation of the fairing size and the impact of the launch vibrations, thereby enabling very large size antennae and improved system performance. Manufacturing and assemblyprocesses for on-orbit manufacturing have been proposed and tested on ground by several actors,including in Europe. The first in orbit demonstration missions for in-situ manufacturing and assemblyof spacecraft components are scheduled in the U.S. before 2025.This activity proposes to select, develop and demonstrate a process relevant to future on-orbitmanufacturing of large antenna reflectors. The process to be developed could be an on-orbit manufacturing technique,to produce antenna structural components (e.g. antenna frame structural beam, boom, reflective surface elements) or an on-orbit assembly technique, to join structural components together (e.g. joining of reflector membrane on the antenna structure frame). The emphasis will be put on continuous or semi-continuous processes (over batch processes). This, inorder to address antenna concepts involving large structural elements (e.g. large mesh or trussstructure), as opposed to concepts relying on assembly of a high number of small constitutive elements, which have been explored in previous activities.The activity encompasses the following tasks:- Reviewof use cases for very large antenna reflectors- Review of existing and potential solutions for on-orbit manufacturing and assemblyof large antenna reflector structural elements (composites, polymers, metals, ceramics)- Definition of requirements for the manufacturing method- Trade-off and selection of manufacturing method to be developed- Manufacturing and characterization of small-scalespecimens- Design and manufacturing of a breadboard and demonstration of elemental performance requirements- Development plan towards on-orbit demonstration.

title: Technical support for operational equipment
description: The objective of this tender is the acquisition of the needed maintenance and supply support services to ensure the maximum operational availability to the user of Frontex operational equipment (technical and supporting equipment), during operations. Frontex intends to create the technical support services capability that will cover: 1. The virtual ServiceDesk service (Single Point of Contact for users); 2. The Remote 1st Level of technical support service; 3. The Remote or In-Field 2nd Level of technical support service; 4. The In-Field 3nd Level management of technical support service; 5. The In-Field technical maintenance service; 6. The contribution to integrated logistical support service; 7. The technical support Auxiliary Services (for example Root cause technical analysis reports for unforeseen events, auditing related functions, feasibility studies, design functions, special quality reviews, etc.); 8. The In-Field equipment-specific specialized training service. The future Contractor(s) will cover all the above-listed services, involving Frontex staff and other contractors for the support of Frontex in Field equipment (for example Patrol Cars and transportation vehicles, transport and storage services, warranty, repair, tooling, consumables, parts, insurance, labelling & so on). Frontex intends to establish one Framework Contract to cover the centrally provisioned services and two defined per type of equipment Framework Contracts for services in the field, with the following description: Lot 1 - Central technical support for Frontex equipment (Implementation, ServiceDesk, all remote maintenance coordination and training coordination services); Lot 2 - In-Field technical support, maintenance and training services of Portable Technical Equipment (Binocular, Borescope, Cooled Thermal Camera with Tripod, Night Vision Binocular, Night Vision Goggle, SmartDec Camera, Stabiscope, Non Cooled Thermal Camera, CO2 Detector, Heartbeat detector, Jammer Detector, Radiation detector, Spectrometer, Power Generator (Large), Power Generator (Small), Uninterruptible power supply, Radio communication equipment, Document checking device, Document Reader, Fingerprinting Scanner (EURODAC),On-Board-Diagnostic) and In-Field technical support (preventive maintenance (only basic checks)) of Supporting Equipment (certain Information Communication Technology (ICT) equipment (such as conference camera, docking station, laptop, mobile phone, monitor, printer, tablet, video projector, video projector), and Protective Equipment (bulletproof vest, helmet)); Lot 3 - In-Field technical support, maintenance and training services of Vehicular Systems (Mobile Surveillance Systems (MSS) and Vehicles for Migration Management (VMM)) The duration of the FWC, due to the nature of the required maintenance services and the expected lifecycle of Frontex operational equipment, may be longer than the standard 48 months, however, at this stage its exact duration cannot be precisely given. In case of longer duration, the respective estimated values will be increased proportionally.
